name: pushti-shangar
description: Pusti Shangar monorepo: customer storefront, admin panel, and API server

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --workspace client run build && npm --workspace adminpanel run build && npm --workspace server run build
